wiki.title: Jeff Timberlake
wiki.extract: Jeffrey Timberlake is an American politician from Maine. A Republican, Timberlake represents District 17 in the Maine Senate, having previously represented District 22. Previously, he served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2010 to 2018. In the House, Timberlake represented District 96, which Hebron, Minot and his residence in Turner. He earned an associate degree in business management from Central Maine Community College. He is also a former member of the Turner Planning Board.
